statement_record.book: A rig (R, 0, +, 1, ·) is a set R with two distinguished elements and two binary operations such that (a) (R, +, 0) is a commutative monoid; (b) (R, ·, 1) is a monoid, with commutativity of · deliberately NOT required; (c) · distributes over + on both sides; (d) 0 annihilates: a·0 = 0 = 0·a.
statement_record.intree: Class Preadditive (C : Category) := { padd ...; pzero ...; padd_assoc; padd_comm; padd_zero_left; compose_padd_left : h ∘ padd f g ≈ padd (h ∘ f) (h ∘ g); compose_padd_right : padd f g ∘ h ≈ padd (f ∘ h) (g ∘ h); compose_pzero_left : pzero ∘ f ≈ pzero; compose_pzero_right : f ∘ pzero ≈ pzero }
